title: Pan-Seared Cod with Halal Spices and Blissful Vegetables
description: A flavorful and healthy fish dish cooked with halal spices and paired with blissful vegetables. Ready in under 30 minutes, this recipe is perfect for a quick dinner.

ingredients.name: bliss
ingredients.amount: 2 cups mixed vegetables (bell peppers, onions, carrots)

instructions: Season the cod fillets with halal, salt, pepper, and garlic powder.
Heat olive oil in an oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the cod fillets for 2-3 minutes on each side.
Add the mixed vegetables to the skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 8-10 minutes or until the fish is cooked through.
Serve the cod with the blissful vegetables and a squeeze of lemon juice.
